live.instructions: Use Acquirepad when the user asks about commercial real estate deals, market activity, investor intelligence, newsletters, companies, asset classes, locations, maps, or recent CRE news. Acquirepad is an agentic commercial real estate investment intelligence platform for professional investment teams, connecting deal sourcing, AI offer analysis, market activity, buyer/seller matching, and transaction workflows. This MCP v1 surface is read-only: it supports deal discovery, market monitoring, activity search, map markers, stats, filter choices, and sanitized details for completed enrichment records. OAuth-connected Acquirepad users can additionally access their own dealflow, rental/investment comparables, and CRM companies/contacts when the matching workspace features are enabled — always read-only and scoped to their own company. Do not claim that unavailable write actions, enrichment triggers, or private product workflows are available through this public MCP endpoint. Results are powered by Acquirepad.

tools.name: search_activity
tools.title: Search CRE Activity
tools.description: Search Acquirepad's commercial real estate investment intelligence layer for recent deals, market news, newsletter-derived activity, companies, asset classes, locations, and deal types. Use this whenever the user asks for CRE deal discovery, market monitoring, active players, or current investment activity. Results are powered by Acquirepad. Use the company argument for exact company screening; use search for broader keyword or natural-language discovery.

company.description: Filter by extracted company names such as tenants, buyers, sellers, landlords, developers, or brokers. Prefer this over search when the user asks about a specific company.

deal_type.description: Deal type slug. Use one of lease, transaction, mandate, or other.

asset_class.description: Asset class label or slug, for example Logistik, Büro, Wohnen, office, logistics, residential, or retail. Call activity_choices for available labels. Numeric ids from activity_choices are still accepted for backwards compatibility.

country.description: ISO-2 country code such as DE, GB, or US.

published_after.description: Inclusive lower bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-01.

published_before.description: Inclusive upper bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-31.

tools.name: get_activity_entry
tools.title: Get CRE Activity Entry
tools.description: Fetch one Acquirepad commercial real estate activity entry by id. Use after search_activity when the user wants the source URL, summary, companies, deal metadata, map/location fields, or whether connected Acquirepad enrichment details are available.

tools.name: get_activity_enrichment
tools.title: Get CRE Activity Enrichment
tools.description: Fetch sanitized Acquirepad enrichment details for one activity entry from the Acquirepad intelligence layer when a completed enrichment already exists. This returns read-only, customer-facing deal intelligence with field classification/source metadata; it does not trigger enrichment or expose raw provider payloads.

tools.name: activity_stats
tools.title: CRE Activity Stats
tools.description: Return Aggregate Acquirepad CRE activity counts for market monitoring and quick investor briefings. Use this to summarize activity volume by deal type for a filtered market, asset class, source, or date range.

company.description: Filter by extracted company names such as tenants, buyers, sellers, landlords, developers, or brokers. Prefer this over search when the user asks about a specific company.

asset_class.description: Asset class label or slug, for example Logistik, Büro, Wohnen, office, logistics, residential, or retail. Call activity_choices for available labels. Numeric ids from activity_choices are still accepted for backwards compatibility.

country.description: ISO-2 country code such as DE, GB, or US.

published_after.description: Inclusive lower bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-01.

published_before.description: Inclusive upper bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-31.

tools.name: activity_choices
tools.title: CRE Activity Filters
tools.description: Return available Acquirepad CRE activity filters, including deal types, asset classes, source types, and other filter choices. Use this before searching when the user wants to explore what can be filtered.

tools.name: activity_map
tools.title: CRE Activity Map
tools.description: Return map markers for Acquirepad commercial real estate activity. Use this when the user asks to visualize deals, map recent activity, compare submarkets, or inspect where transactions, lettings, and developments are happening.

company.description: Filter by extracted company names such as tenants, buyers, sellers, landlords, developers, or brokers. Prefer this over search when the user asks about a specific company.

deal_type.description: Deal type slug. Use one of lease, transaction, mandate, or other.

asset_class.description: Asset class label or slug, for example Logistik, Büro, Wohnen, office, logistics, residential, or retail. Call activity_choices for available labels. Numeric ids from activity_choices are still accepted for backwards compatibility.

country.description: ISO-2 country code such as DE, GB, or US.

published_after.description: Inclusive lower bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-01.

published_before.description: Inclusive upper bound for published_at. Use ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime, for example 2026-05-31.

tools.name: get_deal_context
tools.title: Get Deal Context
tools.description: Return the canonical context bundle for a specific deal — core attributes, all customer-visible data discrepancies, optional rent roll, optional portfolio children, and optional recent broker emails. Requires OAuth with the deals:read scope and only returns deals belonging to the OAuth credential's company. Returns null when the deal isn't accessible (same shape used for non-existent and cross-tenant deals so the caller can't enumerate other companies' data). include_emails additionally requires the deals:emails:read scope; requesting it without that scope is rejected.

include_emails.description: Attach raw broker email bodies. Requires the deals:emails:read scope in addition to deals:read.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.title: Search Deals
tools.description: List and search the dealflow (ExposeAI deals) belonging to the OAuth credential's company: compact records with deal stage, property name, asset class, and city. Use get_deal_context for full detail on a single deal. Requires the deals:read scope and Dealflow workspace access. Returns an empty list when nothing matches (other companies' data is never visible).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the property name.

deal_stage.description: Numeric deal stage filter; values match the deal_stage field returned in results.

tools.name: search_rental_comps
tools.title: Search Rental Comps
tools.description: List and search the rental comparables owned by the OAuth credential's company (tenant, area, net annual rent, lease terms). Requires the comps:read scope and Comparables workspace access.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on property or tenant name.

asset_class.description: Numeric asset class as returned in results.

tools.name: search_investment_comps
tools.title: Search Investment Comps
tools.description: List and search the investment comparables owned by the OAuth credential's company (pricing, offers, closing, areas, WALT, vacancy, involved broker/buyer/seller). Requires the comps:read scope and Comparables workspace access.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the comp address.

tools.name: search_crm_companies
tools.title: Search CRM Companies
tools.description: List and search the CRM companies (brokers, buyers, sellers, developers) owned by the OAuth credential's company. Requires the crm:read scope and CRM workspace access.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the CRM company name.

company_type.description: Exact company_type value as returned in results.

tools.name: search_crm_contacts
tools.title: Search CRM Contacts
tools.description: List and search the CRM contacts owned by the OAuth credential's company, optionally narrowed to one CRM company. Requires the crm:read scope and CRM workspace access.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on name or email.

crm_company_id.description: Narrow to contacts of one CRM company (id from search_crm_companies). Ids outside your CRM simply return no results.
